subject: Approval: Summer intern return offers & comp band clearance
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Summer intern return offers & comp band clearance

Hi Laura / Monica —

We're wrapping up return-offer decisions for the three interns who rotated through Infra and Platform this summer. Attached are the short evals and a proposed compensation band for each. I need headcount and comp-band sign-off so Talent can finalize letters and send offers next week. Summary: 

- Jessica Johnson (SWE intern, Infra) — proposed band: $95k base (new-grad SWE IC2-equivalent) — strong backend + KV cache profiling work; manager recommends hire.
- Chen Li (SWE intern, Platform) — proposed band: $105k base (SWE IC3-equivalent; candidate has prior internship and strong systems design) — manager recommends elevated band.
- Omar Hassan (SRE intern, Reliability) — proposed band: $92k base (SRE IC2-equivalent) — strong on-call attitude; requires on-call training.

Asks: 
1) Laura — can you confirm these fit within the approved new-grad budget and that payroll codes/headcount are available?
2) Monica — please confirm manager-level approval on the bands and whether Chen should be elevated to the IC3 band before offer.
3) Aditya — once we have sign-off, can you prepare the offer letters and make sure equity / sign-on is aligned to band?

Attachments: eval_johnson.pdf, eval_chen.pdf, eval_hassan.pdf. Also attached an editable offer template (summer_offer_template.docx).

Timeline: we want offers out by Friday (2026-04-09) to secure acceptance before other campus offers.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer intern return offers & comp band clearance

Thanks for the note and the evals, Markus — good summaries. Quick responses below.

On Sun, Apr 5, 2026 at 4:14 PM, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> We're wrapping up return-offer decisions for the three interns...

Budget/headcount: I checked with finance. We have 3 open new-grad headcount slots allocated to Engineering Campus Hires for Q3 headcount (bucket: ENG-CAMPUS-2026). Approving the hires will consume those three slots. Payroll codes are available (see "Workday WD-5782").

Comp bands: 
- Jessica ($95k): OK within the IC2 band. Recommend we hold equity at the standard new-grad grant for IC2.
- Chen ($105k): This is at the top of the IC3 range. Before approving IC3, I need manager confirmation that Chen's scope aligns with IC3 expectations (ownership, cross-team impact). Monica — please confirm. If you want to keep Chen at IC2+ (i.e., $100k + slightly larger equity) that would also be acceptable from a comp governance perspective.
- Omar ($92k): OK for SRE IC2; note that SRE role has mandatory on-call certification — include this in the offer conditions.

I can approve on headcount and payroll codes now. For Chen's band, I'll need Monica's explicit confirmation if we elevate to IC3.

Next steps: once Monica confirms Chen's band, Aditya should prepare offers with respective conditions (on-call training for Omar, IC-level grant for Chen note).

Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer intern return offers & comp band clearance

Thanks for the details — happy to own the offer production. A few operational notes: 

- I'll draft offers in the standard campus template (attached: summer_offer_template.docx) and send for legal review by EOD Tuesday.
- Equity: default new-grad RSU grant at IC2 = 0.08% (prorated for start date), IC3 = 0.12%. If we keep Chen at an elevated IC2+ compensation structure, we can increase RSU by ~15% without pushing to IC3.
- Signing bonus / relocation: none standard for these cohorts; if managers want exceptions, tell me and we'll route for approval.
- Workday codes: ENG-CAMPUS-2026 (headcount), PAY-ENG-IC2, PAY-ENG-IC3. I'll attach the Workday ticket number to the offer package (WD-5782).

I'll wait for Monica's signal on Chen's band, then circulate the three draft offers for Laura's and Legal's sign-off. Can confirm we will aim to hit the Friday outbound deadline.

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Summer intern return offers & comp band clearance

Markus / all — quick confirmation from me on manager side: 

- Jessica Johnson: Full hire approved at $95k base, IC2 band. She demonstrated ownership of a backend performance project and shipped measurable latency improvements.
- Chen Li: Recommend elevation to IC3 band at $105k. Chen led a small design review with infra and showed cross-team impact; we want to lock him at IC3 to avoid losing him to competitor offers. Approve IC3 and associated RSU (0.12%).
- Omar Hassan: Approve at $92k, IC2 for SRE. Include mandatory on-call training & 90-day probation for production on-call.

Markus — you have my manager approval on banding. Laura — please proceed with headcount and payroll allocation. Aditya — please circulate the offer drafts to the candidates with the stated conditions and Workday ticket attached.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
